title_original: 감사원 전문인력 및 전문직위의 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Evaluation and Revocation of Selection)
(1) Specialized personnel shall have their performance as specialized personnel, including work performance and education and training, evaluated annually by the Committee.
(2) The Committee may revoke the selection of specialized personnel if they fail to perform the roles prescribed in Article 5, fail to complete the specialized education prescribed in Article 6, wish to have their selection revoked, or are found, as a result of an evaluation by the Committee, to be markedly deficient in ability and qualifications.
(3) Where a specialized position becomes vacant due to the revocation of a person's selection as specialized personnel, the Chairperson shall select other specialized personnel and assign them to that specialized position.
(4) A person whose selection as specialized personnel has been revoked shall not be selected again as specialized personnel for two years from the date of revocation.
